summary: Three behavioural regressions hidden in the refactor.

findings.claim: Tax is now computed on the undiscounted subtotal instead of the taxable (discounted) amount.
findings.evidence: tax = tax_cents(sub, tax_bps) replaced tax_cents(taxable, tax_bps)

findings.claim: The idempotency check runs after the id is added to seen, so every event is treated as a duplicate.
A successful send no longer returns; the loop keeps sending on the remaining attempts (double send).
findings.evidence: return resp replaced by last = resp with no break
